title: 第23章 你是那个杂役弟子第24章 你讲的是催眠诀
content_zh:
方元看到自己默默守护了多年的小师妹，就这么答应了人家，心里多少有点不是滋味。
但他也知道自己是什么档次，有些东西是自己的就一定是自己的，不是自己的那就要有点自知之明。
但只要将这条金大腿抱稳，等修炼有成，要什么样的女人没有？
这么一想，他瞬间就看开了。
三人很快就来到了山顶。
白锦儿刚一踏上山顶的石阶，便忍不住深吸了一口气浓郁的灵气。
这山顶上的灵气浓郁程度可是山下的十倍。
也就意味着这里的修炼速度比山下要快上十倍。
如果不是纯小白，带领她来到这里，凭她这种炼气五层的弟子，根本就没有资格来到山顶。
这是青云宗特意设计的一种，推着弟子往上爬的规则，你想休闲资源比别人好，比别人快。
那你就多做任务，提升实力，才能住更好的房子，得到最好的资源。
路过方元的洞府时，方元冲着二人拱了拱手，便灰溜溜的钻进了隔壁自己的洞府。
……
“师妹，来，帮我开启一下阵法。”
一进院门，纯小白就将那枚阵符递给了白锦儿。
白锦儿微微一愣。
这玉符相当家里钥匙，怎么如此轻易就交给别人？
而且，这还不是她最疑惑的，最疑惑的是，纯师兄一道神识就能打开阵法，自己开不就行了，为何要让她来开？
不过她也没多想，只当是纯师兄想表达对自己的信任。
她耳根子微微一红，随后凝结一道神识，小心翼翼地探入阵符之中。

“嗡！”
阵符发出一道玄光，院子周围的遮掩阵、屏蔽阵、防御阵便瞬间开启，一层淡淡的光幕将整个小院笼罩其中。
“嗯！”
纯小白见状，一把将阵符收了回来。
这下，这个小姑娘想跑可就没那么容易了！
白锦儿看到他这个眼神，觉得似曾相识。
“怎么回事？”
“我怎么又觉得他就是那个杂役弟子了？”
纯小白直接将白锦儿带到修炼室，抬手一翻，取出一瓶聚灵丹递过去。
“来，师妹，这些是我吃不完的丹药，送你了。”
“这……！”白锦儿有些不好意思，抬起手开始推辞。
可就在碰倒丹药瓶的时候，鬼使神差的接了下。
“哎呀，我的脸皮什么时候变这么厚？”
她才小脸撞得通红，随时看一下纯小白，心里涌起一股感动。
实在没想到这纯师兄，境界高深，出手这么大方。
content_en:
Fang Yuan felt a little uncomfortable when he saw that his junior sister, whom he had silently guarded for many years, agreed to her promise.
But he also knows what level he is. If something is his, it must be his. If it is not his, he must be self-aware.
But as long as you hold this golden thigh firmly and achieve success in cultivation, what kind of woman would you want?
When he thought about it, he looked away instantly.
The three of them soon reached the top of the mountain.
As soon as Bai Jin'er stepped onto the stone steps at the top of the mountain, she couldn't help but take a deep breath of rich spiritual energy.
The spiritual energy on the top of the mountain is ten times stronger than at the bottom.
This means that the cultivation speed here is ten times faster than at the foot of the mountain.
If Chun Xiaobai hadn't led her here, a disciple like her at the fifth level of Qi refining wouldn't be qualified to come to the top of the mountain.
This is a rule specially designed by Qingyun Sect to push disciples to climb up. If you want to have better leisure resources than others and be faster than others.
Then you have to do more tasks and improve your strength so that you can live in a better house and get the best resources.
When passing by Fang Yuan's cave, Fang Yuan bowed his hands to the two of them and then went into his own cave next door in despair.
…
"Junior sister, come on, help me activate the formation."
As soon as he entered the courtyard, Chun Xiaobai handed the formation talisman to Bai Jin'er.
Bai Jin'er was slightly startled.
This jade talisman is like a key to the house. How could it be given to others so easily?
Moreover, this is not what puzzles her the most. The most puzzling thing is that Senior Brother Chun can open the formation with just one spiritual consciousness. If she can do it by herself, why should she do it?
But she didn't think much about it and just thought it was Senior Brother Chun who wanted to express his trust in her.
Her ears turned slightly red, and then she condensed a spiritual consciousness and carefully probed into the formation talisman.
"Buzz!"
The formation talisman emits a mysterious light, and the covering formation, shielding formation, and defense formation around the courtyard are instantly activated, and a faint light curtain envelopes the entire small courtyard.
"Yeah!"
Seeing this, Chun Xiaobai took back the formation talisman.
Now, it will not be so easy for this little girl to run away!
When Bai Jin'er saw his look, she felt like she had seen him before.
"What's going on?"
"Why do I think he is the handyman disciple again?"
Chun Xiaobai took Bai Jin'er directly to the training room, raised his hand, took out a bottle of Spirit Gathering Pill and handed it over.
"Come on, junior sister, these are the elixirs that I can't finish, so I give them to you."
"This...!" Bai Jin'er was a little embarrassed, raised her hand and began to refuse.
But just when he knocked down the elixir bottle, he accidentally picked it up.
"Geez, when did I become so thick-skinned?"
Her little face turned red, and whenever she looked at Chun Xiaobai, she felt a surge of emotion in her heart.
I really didn’t expect that Senior Brother Chun, with his advanced realm, would be so generous with his actions.
